metadata.question: Did the land area of Great Fox Island decrease between 1999 and 2019?

data.raw_code: To answer whether the land area of Great Fox Island decreased between 1999 and 2019, I need to: 1. Find Great Fox Island location - I'll need to search for this island. It's likely in the US based on the name. 2. Use Landsat imagery from 1999 and 2019 3. Calculate land area by identifying land vs water pixels 4. Compare the areas Strategy: - Use Landsat 5 for 1999 and Landsat 8 for 2019 - Calculate NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to separate land from water - Count land pixels and convert to area - Compare the two years Data quality checks: - Check if collections have images - Check if we get valid pixel counts after processing - Validate the results make sense For land/water classification, I'll use NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) - Water typically has positive NDWI values - Land typically has negative NDWI values I'll need to: 1. Define the geometry for Great Fox Island (I'll search for it) 2. Get Landsat 5 for 1999 and Landsat 8 for 2019 3. Calculate NDWI 4. Classify land/water 5. Count land pixels and calculate area 6. Compare 1999 vs 2019 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Great Fox Island is in Virginia, USA (Eastern Shore) const greatFoxIsland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-75.732, 37.400], [-75.728, 37.400], [-75.728, 37.404], [-75.732, 37.404], [-75.732, 37.400] ]]); const date1999 = ['1999-01-01', '1999-12-31']; const date2019 = ['2019-01-01', '2019-12-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1999, Landsat 8 for 2019 const landsat5_1999 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(greatFoxIsland) .filterDate(date1999[0], date1999[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); const landsat8_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(greatFoxIsland) .filterDate(date2019[0], date2019[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 20)); // Check if collections have data const count1999 = landsat5_1999.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = landsat8_2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Images: ${count1999}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count1999 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const img1999 = landsat5_1999.median(); const img2019 = landsat8_2019.median(); // Function to calculate NDWI and classify land/water function calculateLandArea(img, landsatType) { let green, nir; if (landsatType === 'L5') { green = img.select('SR_B2'); // Green band for Landsat 5 nir = img.select('SR_B4'); // NIR band for Landsat 5 } else { // Landsat 8 green = img.select('SR_B3'); // Green band for Landsat 8 nir = img.select('SR_B5'); // NIR band for Landsat 8 } // Calculate NDWI const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)); // Classify: land = NDWI < 0, water = NDWI >= 0 const landMask = ndwi.lt(0); // Count land pixels const pixelCount = landMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: greatFoxIsland, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('constant'); return pixelCount; } // Calculate land areas const landArea1999 = calculateLandArea(img1999, 'L5').getInfo(); const landArea2019 = calculateLandArea(img2019, 'L8').getInfo(); console.log(`1999 Land Pixels: ${landArea1999}`); console.log(`2019 Land Pixels: ${landArea2019}`); // Check for valid pixels if (landArea1999 === 0 || landArea2019 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (landArea1999 === null || landArea2019 === null || isNaN(landArea1999) || isNaN(landArea2019)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate area in square meters (30m resolution) const area1999 = landArea1999 * 30 * 30; const area2019 = landArea2019 * 30 * 30; console.log(`1999 Area: ${area1999.toFixed(0)} m²`); console.log(`2019 Area: ${area2019.toFixed(0)} m²`); console.log(`Change: ${((area2019 - area1999) / area1999 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // Determine answer if (area2019 < area1999) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
